items.text: Modified/individual training Thursday with calf sleeve, day-to-day; unlikely to start vs Australia 3pm ET — bench at best.
Expected to start vs Saudi Arabia Sunday; Yamal + Nico Williams in for Ferran Torres and Gavi.
No fitness concerns; expected to captain Türkiye from deep-lying playmaker role vs Paraguay tonight at Levi's.
Will NOT play or travel to Philadelphia for Haiti match; medical staff targeting knockout-stage return, not the Scotland group finale.
Renard switches to 4-3-3: Dahmen; Valery, Bronn, Talbi, Abdi; Skhiri, Mejbri, Ben Slimane; Achouri, Chaouat, Saad. Mejbri given roaming No.10 license.
Mitoma cut pre-tournament (hamstring); Kubo now also out (knee) for MD2 — Sugawara likely starts right wing-back, Doan pushes forward in 3-man attack with Maeda and Ueda.
